Yarra River Water Quality (Cleaned Dataset) — yarra_river_data
text: data frame N rows 7 variables: site_id Character. Monitoring site identifier. datetime POSIXct. Timestamp observation (local time). ph Numeric. Acidity/alkalinity water (0–14 scale). salinity_ec25 Numeric. Electrical conductivity 25°C (\(\mu\)S/cm), used proxy salinity. turbidity Numeric. Turbidity (NTU), higher values indicate murkier water. nitrogen_total Numeric. Total nitrogen concentration (mg/L), key nutrient linked algal growth. water_temperature Numeric. Water temperature (°C), affects dissolved oxygen species tolerance.
